Data:Slnev.arthur.douglas.json.startdescription: Douglas greets Arthur with a handshake and an 'Uncle'. Arthur addresses him smilingly as 'young Douggie.' Then both men hesitate, clearly grappling with the reminder that Douglas looks twenty years older than Arthur. When he next speaks, Douglas' voice cracks just for a moment. Then they spend the rest of the evening talking very practically about Edge-long. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]

Data:Slnev.arthur.ehsan.json.startdescription: Arthur and Ehsan discuss Anaël Verdier's account of the ascent of the 'Unwise Mortal' to the heights of the Mansus - perhaps even to the Glory - and how he, perhaps, succeeded when so many others failed. 'I learnt in my time here' - Ehsan gestures to indicate the House - 'that it can be as important who witnesses a deed, as who performs it.' Arthur nods, slowly. [Lesson: Watchman's Paradoxes]

Data:Slnev.arthur.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser had, it seemed, ignored Arthur's warnings about the Althiban Abyss, and had travelled there hoping to find a great remnant of the Carapace Cross - perhaps even a lost dragon. Just as Arthur warned him, he found something hatched and grown in a decaying tendril of the Seven-Coils - something that had acquired the Worm-nature. 'I had known it was possible for the Cross to turn,' he laments, 'but I had hoped never to see it.' [Lesson: Coil & Chasm]

Data:Slnev.arthur.hokobald.json.startdescription: Hokobald is lecturing Arthur on the strategy and tactics of the War of the Roads - specifically, the ways in which the natures of the Sovereigns of the Leashed Flame became manifest through their choices in battle. Arthur listens politely. [Lesson: Meniscate Reflections]

Data:Slnev.arthur.morgen.json.startdescription: Morgen smilingly entreats Arthur to speak to her of the 'Flaw in the Glass' - the menace that Omar the Blaze identified in the enclosure of a sacred flame at the Labyrinth of Lions. She is at her most charming, and even Arthur - not a man one might expect to be susceptible to Morgen's charms - unbends enough to drop a few hints. [Lesson: Glaziery & Lightsmithing]

Data:Slnev.arthur.olympe.json.startdescription: Arthur and Olympe debate the hypothetical City Unbuilt, the dwelling-place of perfect balance. Olympe suggests it might be achievable in the Moon-marches, or even the House of the Moon. Arthur believes it's better as an unachievable ideal - especially since the Meniscate, the Hour of perfect balance, is one of the trio of Chancel Hours, and the other two might prefer to limit her power by forbidding the City. [Lesson: Meniscate Reflections]

Data:Slnev.arthur.serena.json.startdescription: Arthur speaks of the light that supposedly dwelt in the Wood before the coming of the Gods-from-Light: he suggests it might be the redder Sun of the gods-who-were-stone. Serena thinks it is simply fire - 'if we can ever say 'simply' of the Wood.' [Lesson: Pyroglyphics]

Data:Slnev.arthur.stanislav.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Arthur argue happily about which herbal tisane tastes the most disgusting, and hence is most useful to speed lingering guests on their way. [Lesson: Herbs & Infusions]

Data:Slnev.arthur.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Arthur and Denzil are having a stilted but friendly conversation about the local beer. [Lesson: Spices & Savours]

Data:Slnev.arthur.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Arthur and Mr Kille are exchanging stories about the wilder days of their childhood in Castleford and in Brancrug, the scrapes they got into; both are chuckling, but both grow quiet when they realise that Arthur's childhood was much, much longer ago.

Data:Slnev.arthur.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Timothy and Arthur are discussing Isaac of Karth's History of the Shadowless Kings. Arthur is sceptical of Isaac of Karth's reliability; Timothy is a ferocious admirer. [Lesson: Sand Stories]

Data:Slnev.arthur.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette is fascinated by the language-of-signs called Sabazine, in which Arthur is proficient. He teaches her a few signs, but she grows suddenly frightened and asks him to stop. [Lesson: Sabazine]

Data:Slnev.arthur.zachary.json.startdescription: Arthur and Zachary reminisce about London at night - how it has changed, and how they have changed. [Lesson: Ragged Crossroads]

Data:Slnev.arun.agdistis.json.startdescription: Arun and Agdistis are discussing the technical details of flensing, without any particular regard for the effect it might have on anyone's appetite. [Lesson: Stitching & Binding]

Data:Slnev.arun.aladim.json.startdescription: Arun, complacently: 'The traveller is always returning. One who does not is no traveller.' Al-Adim, waspishly: 'Tell that to my patroness.' [Lesson: Path & Pilgrim]

Data:Slnev.arun.arthur.json.startdescription: Arun and Arthur are reminiscing about the city of Pune, though Arun has not visited it, he confides, since the time of the Maratha Empire. 'One exile after another; the pentiment's fate. Exile is addictive. You'll learn that too.'  [Lesson: Sickle & Eclipse]

Data:Slnev.arun.azita.json.startdescription: Arun and Azita speak of the Tragulari, the 'Dartsmen' who once used exotic poisons to hunt immortals. Arun expresses distaste for the Colonel's part in the Tragulari's creation, but Azita is unabashed: 'Good exercise. Honestly, I miss them.' Arun flatly refuses to believe her. [Lesson: Sharps]

Data:Slnev.arun.chaima.json.startdescription: Arun and Chaima are speaking of the 'Younger Sisters' of the Mother of Ants, whom Chaima has hunted in the past. 'There are not so many of them left in serpent-form,' Arun tells her. 'The world changes, and they take human form. As the dragons did.' [Lesson: Hill & Hollow]

Data:Slnev.arun.connie.json.startdescription: Arun is brightly asking Connie detailed questions about the connections between the Bureau and the Calyptra. Connie, clearly struggling to suppress her outrage, is answering them as tactfully and evasively as she can. [Lesson: Edicts Inviolable]

Data:Slnev.arun.coquille.json.startdescription: 'We all loved Vak, back home,' Arun sighs. Coquille nods, her eyes glowing. 'You remember the poems we wrote for her? In other languages, of course. Except me; I wrote a poem to her, in her. I got in a great deal of trouble for that. Again.' He recites a few verses, and Coquille claps her hands in delight. [Lesson: Vak]

Data:Slnev.arun.corso.json.startdescription: Arun and Corso are discussing a scheme to track down valuable books by observing the effects of their ink on the dreams of those nearby, but Corso subsides into a sulk when it becomes apparent that Arun is not taking the idea seriously. [Lesson: Inks of Revelation]

Data:Slnev.arun.dagmar.json.startdescription: Arun and Dagmar greet each other with delight and are soon engaged in another round of their perennial riddle-game. 'What is the difference,' Arun asks 'between a Twin?' Dagmar roars happily, 'One of its Names is both the same!' [Lesson: Edicts Liminal]

Data:Slnev.arun.douglas.json.startdescription: Douglas has tracked down the Long-in-the-making of whom Arun warned him last time. Arun congratulates him; Douglas describes, with distaste, the empty eyes of his target's victims… [Lesson: Maggephene Mysteries]

Data:Slnev.arun.ehsan.json.startdescription: Arun and Ehsan - the ex-skaptodon, the perhaps-ex-Knock-long - talk about how it is to have been something that one no longer is. Ehsan complains that he needs to employ both hammers and nutcrackers, also that his joints have begun to ache when the weather turns. Arun rubs at the bandages on his wrists, and says ruefully: 'But we endure; we endure.' [Lesson: Resurgences & Emergences]

Data:Slnev.arun.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser thanks Arun warmly for the advice that Arun gave him last time about the development of one's venom glands. They chat wryly about the difficulties of expressing venom, and the effects of diet on its potency. [Lesson: Serpents & Venoms]

Data:Slnev.arun.hokobald.json.startdescription: Arun and Hokobald are debating the truth of a rumour about Winter-long: that they cannot sire or birth children, and so can safely lie together without fear of the Crime of the Sky. Hokobald insists that even were that true, the fruitfulness of Grail-long - or the vigour of Forge-long - would still allow conception. [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.arun.morgen.json.startdescription: Morgen and Arun discuss the secluded order of Long known as the Obliviates; the triple oath they take, and their sanctuary in the island of Noon, which Morgen speaks of fondly. [Lesson: Sacra Limiae]

Data:Slnev.arun.olympe.json.startdescription: Olympe is trying to get to the bottom of Arun's opinions on the New King. He is answering only in riddles, but she seems to find his answers illuminating. [Lesson: Transformations & Liberations]

Data:Slnev.arun.serena.json.startdescription: Arun and Serena discuss the contraband manual of inks called 'From History to Eternity', and speculate as to the identity of its author. Serena wonders if it might have been Edith Abney-Hastings, now the Nocturnal Secretary responsible for the entire Suppression Bureau, but Arun scoffs. [Lesson: Inks of Revelation]

Data:Slnev.arun.stanislav.json.startdescription: Arun and Stanislav compare the sacred places where it is fitting to spill blood; those where the spilling of blood is welcome; and those where one may only spill one's own. [Lesson: Rites of the Roots]

Data:Slnev.arun.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Denzil and Arun are enjoying an unexpectedly cordial conversation, though Arun is doing most of the talking. Arun asks, evidently not for the first time, when Denzil is going to visit him in London, but Denzil only shakes his head stolidly; and the conversation cools a little, after. [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.arun.visiting.killes.json.startdescription:
Arun leans towards Mrs Kille. 'My family,' he says significantly,'perceives time as a flame: coolest at its heart, but wildest at its edge…' Mrs Kille shrugs, and says: 'Every flame has its fuel; every fuel fears its flame.'
Arun draws his head back to regard her, in a more than usually ophidian mode. 'Huh,' he suggests. [Lesson: Purifications & Exaltations]

Data:Slnev.arun.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Since their last meeting, Reverend Timothy has actually read Arun's 'The Radical Measure', and is boiling with detailed questions about it. Arun's memory of the book is obviously a little hazier than Timothy, and he tries to retreat into his habitual conversational thicket of riddles; but the ingenuity of Timothy's enthusiasm is merciless. [Lesson: Preliminal Meter]

Data:Slnev.arun.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette and Arun revisit an innuendo-laced conversation about a possible entanglement between Vak and Henavek. Each recites poetry in their language of preference. Before very long, they have drawn their chairs closer together so they can whisper the poetry in one another's ears. [Lesson: Rhyme & Remembrance]

Data:Slnev.arun.zachary.json.startdescription: Zachary asks Arun about the fabled war between the Great Hooded Princes and the Obliviates. Arun favours Zachary with his triangular smile. 'It wasn't really a war. Mother Many-Armed just took offence at some of their rites. Well, their habits. And we were all still her children...' [Lesson: Edicts Liminal]

Data:Slnev.azita.agdistis.json.startdescription: Azita and Agdistis are discussing the roles played in the world's sustention by the Thunderskin ('who does not permit conclusion') and the Corrivality (the eternal contest of the Edge-powers). They agree it's a business that could only be entrusted to Hours familiar with suffering... [Lesson: Edicts Martial]

Data:Slnev.azita.aladim.json.startdescription: Al-Adim and Azita are reminiscing about the time of their first acquaintance in the city of Damascus, in the days before the coming of Timur. 'Good fighting!' she sighs. 'I preferred the hawking,' he says; and they spend some time discussing desert falconry. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.azita.arthur.json.startdescription: Azita is describing her experiences in the Mansus to Arthur - who, it seems, has never passed the Stag Door, though he speaks fondly of its watchman. [Lesson: Watchman's Paradoxes]

Data:Slnev.azita.arun.json.startdescription: Azita and Arun speak of conversations they both had long ago with the witch Ninegala of Lagash about Vak - identified with the Peacock Door - and Calyptra. 'The goddess! She was very bad for me,' Arun sighs, 'but much worse for poor Ghirbi. That's how he came about his interest in doors. And goddesses.' [Lesson: Sickle & Eclipse]

Data:Slnev.azita.chaima.json.startdescription: Chaima listens as Azita discusses the death of the God-from-Stone called Seven-Coils, and the birth of the Mother of Ants. 'I don't think it was pretty,' she tells the younger woman. 'But I wonder if it might not have been beautiful.' [Lesson: Edicts Martial]
